concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-001 cross‑references 'US-1', but no identifier US-1 is defined in the document; the user stories are titled 'User Story 1', 'User Story 2', etc. This makes the requirement ambiguous and untraceable.

Inconsistent terminology: the specification alternates between 'User Story 1' headings and the shorthand 'US-1' used in cross‑references. This unstable naming can cause confusion when tracing requirements to stories.
